_about: Core Dota 2 mechanics in machine-readable form for quick LLM lookup. Formulas are stable across recent patches (7.3x-7.41); constants marked 'verify' change more often, so check the patch notes / in-game tooltip if a patch just dropped.

strength.note: Also adds status-resist-free HP pool; STR heroes get +1 damage per point.

agility.note: AGI heroes get +1 damage per point.

intellect.note: INT heroes get +1 damage per point.

universal.note: Universal heroes get ~0.7 damage per point of EVERY attribute (verify).

physical_damage.insight: Each point of armor is worth more 'effective HP' the more HP you have. Armor reduction (Desolator, Assault, Meld) is multiplicative with crit/attack damage, which is why PA/TA love it.

magic_damage.black_king_bar: Debuff immunity + 60% magic resistance (current item data). Pure damage and many ultimates still pierce.

pure_damage: Ignores armor and magic resistance. Blocked by Debuff Immunity only when the spell itself is blocked.

attack.insight: Lower BAT (base attack time) multiplies all attack speed. Attack speed has diminishing value once you hit the cap; damage/crit becomes better.

evasion_true_strike.evasion_stacking: Multiplicative, like magic resistance (Butterfly 35% + PA Immaterial stack diminishingly).
evasion_true_strike.note: Evasion only works vs attacks. Spells ignore it.

status_effects.status_resistance: Reduces duration of disables (stun, silence, root...). Stacks multiplicatively.
status_effects.slow_resistance: Separate from status resistance; reduces movement/attack slows (S&Y, Abyssal, Morph Ebb and Flow).
status_effects.debuff_immunity: BKB-style: most disables don't apply. 'Pierces debuff immunity' spells still work (e.g. Abyssal Overwhelm, many ults).
status_effects.break: Disables passive abilities (WK lifesteal + Reincarnation, PA Immaterial, Spectre Dispersion). Sources: Silver Edge, Doom, PA Aghanim's Fan of Knives, Viper.

dispel.basic: Removes most buffs/debuffs, NOT stuns. Sources: Manta, Satanic active, Nullifier (on target), BKB on cast.
dispel.strong: Also removes stuns. Sources: Aeon Disk proc, Abaddon Aphotic Shield, Slark Dark Pact. (Disperser dispels self/ally/target; check its tooltip for basic vs strong.)

status_effects.silence_vs_mute: Silence = no spells. Mute = no items. Hex = neither + can't attack.

economy.pull_timings: Small/medium camp pulls around x:15 and x:45 so neutrals meet the wave.
economy.stack_timing: Aggro a camp around x:53-x:55 and lead it out of the spawn box; it respawns at the minute.
economy.deny: Denying a creep gives the enemy reduced XP and no gold. Denying in lane = XP advantage.
economy.streak_bounty: Killing a hero on a kill streak gives extra gold; dying with a streak feeds the enemy.
economy.comeback: The losing team gets bonus gold/XP from kills (catch-up mechanics). A big lead can flip after one bad fight.

map_objects.power_runes: Spawn in river every 2 min from 6:00 (verify). Arc Warden gets permanent stats from them (Runic Infusion).
map_objects.bounty_runes: Every 3 min near the jungle; team gold.
map_objects.wisdom_runes: Every ~7 min at the far map edge (verify); big XP for whoever is behind.
map_objects.tormentor: Spawns mid-game on both sides (~15-20 min, verify). Killing it gives a free Aghanim's Shard to the team.
map_objects.roshan: Moves between two pits (day/night). Drops Aegis (extra life), later also Cheese and more (verify). Respawn 8-11 min.
map_objects.neutral_items: Tiered drops/crafting that unlock around 5/15/25/35/60 min (verify, the system changed in 7.38).

day_night: Day/night cycle of 5 min each. Night = less vision for most heroes, good for ganks.

positions.1: Safe-lane carry. Highest farm priority, weakest early, wins late.
positions.2: Mid. Solo XP, runes, tempo and ganks.
positions.3: Offlaner. Pressures the enemy carry, initiates, front line.
positions.4: Soft support. Roams, makes plays, secondary farm.
positions.5: Hard support. Wards, pulls, saves the carry in lane.
